bayts.text: In the name of the Divinity (Allah) my gift grows, without limit or end.
Praise to my Lord, the best of those who nurture, who has restored my heart through following the example (of the Prophet).
To Him my thanksgiving, without ingratitude; He is my Helper, and from Him comes my ransom.
To Him my drawing near, without estrangement; to Him my words are addressed, together with my right guidance.
Yours my contentment, Yours my praise, Yours my seeking refuge, together with my asking for Your gifts.
O You who have healed me, O You who have shielded me from whoever treated me harshly, by erasing every ill!
Let down Your veils over me, set my affairs in order, multiply my blessings, without toil.
O You who have answered whoever answered You, grant me a response in this call.
O Lord of Beauty, O Lord of Majesty, O Best of Protectors, make my gift pure.
O Lord of Oneness, O Lord of Existence, be with me in generosity, without end.
Make pure my arrival (at You), without heedlessness on my part; grant me generously what I ask, and adorn my mantle with beauty.
Grant me recitation (of the Qur'an) with its sweetness, grant me understanding at the moment I perform it.
You have set my state aright without my having to depart; through me guide my family, without tears.
Accept my repentance and protect my person, preserve my return (to You) and perfect my intelligence.
Keep me from the Deceiver (Satan) and erase the delusions; grant me a victorious help, with firm support.
Lead to me a gift that increases perfection, O You who are exalted above all partners.
You have increased my right guidance, You have led Your gifts to me, to my full contentment, without any complaint.
O Best of those who enrich, who have enriched me by pure favour: Him I praise, without excess.
Yours my thanksgiving in my dwellings, O Lord of the palaces (of Paradise), without exile.
O You who have clothed me, O You who have given me drink, O You who have shielded me from desolation!
You are my spring, You are my pillar: illumine my heart, O Lord of Light.
You have removed my fault, dispelled my doubt, purified my inmost being like that of the pure elect.
You have brought my journey to completion, made my provision good: be with me in goodness, as with the God-fearing.
O Best of those who give life, be with me in Your care and with excellent striving, as with the discerning.
Grant me uprightness, keep me from blame, grant me honour, by him (Muḥammad) who bears the Banner (of Praise),
by the possessor of beauty, by the possessor of perfection, by the possessor of the heights, by the possessor of the remedy,
by him devoted to worship, by him who dispenses benefit, by the wonders that break the ordinary (granted) to the Saints,
by the giver of gifts, the lion of battle, who fells the wretched men,
by him who has the Companions, people of answered prayer, dispeller of sorrow, people of light,
by him of the battles, dispeller of anguish, light of the wise, effacer of ostentation.
He (Muḥammad) is the Illuminating (Al-Munīr), he is the Bearer of glad tidings (Al-Bashīr): to him I point with this praise.
To him my words are addressed, without reproach, without veil and without hardship.
O best of creatures, O possessor of virtues, O possessor of gifts, make my edifice pure.
You (O Prophet) are my joy, without delusion: make pure my piety, illumine my dwelling.
Of you I speak, and I do not lament; to you I return, without fading away.
May the Lord who guided you requite you on my behalf, beyond your wishes, on the Day of Requital.
May my Lord requite you, O best of beloveds, best of those who are loved, without any loss.
Truly I am the Servant (Khadīm), wherever I abide, and I do not depart from this contentment.
You are my protector from the Deceiver (Satan) and from the delusions of the one who calls to wretchedness.
You have guarded my place, increased my hopes: grant me my time, by Him (Allah) who possesses Permanence.
You (Muḥammad) are my path to the King (Allah), you who erase falsehoods and bestow purity.
You are the Beautiful, towards you I incline; you are the Messenger, who asks no wage.
Yours my tongue together with my heart; and I do not approach you as the poets (of this world) do.
You are the Way: through you one reaches Him (Allah) who grants the most precious of riches.
You have removed my nakedness, removed my straying, perfected my judgement like that of the great.
O best of mankind, to you my pens are devoted, without blame, but in full contentment.
O possessor of beauty, O possessor of virtue, you are the Means (Al-Wasīla) to Him (Allah) who holds the Decree.
In you is my trusting repose in the All-Firm (Al-Matīn), without temptation and without end.
O best of servants, gateway of benefactions, light of the lands, my loftiest hope!
You have removed my anguish, erased my wrongdoing: grant me a knowledge that calls to salvation.
You have removed my poverty, kept my secret for me, without guile or satire.
You have purified my soul, undone my captivity, dispelled my confusion, driven the veil away from me.
You have guarded my every horizon, increased my gifts, preserved my being together with the favours.
To you is my return with my multitudes, without hunger and without error.
Towards you I turn, O possessor of gifts, after my prayer of blessing, together with praise.
With you I am content, in you I have forgotten (all else), just as I have been freed from hardship.
